name: admin-proposals
title: Self-improvement: approve the agent's changes to itself from the dashboard
description: The gate of the agent's changes to itself: its pull requests from pikit/self/* listed in the dashboard, with their diff and checks, approved (merged) or rejected there with a token the agent never holds; and the project's CI workflow. Dormant until connected, after deploying: the repository from the dashboard's Settings, the two tokens as secrets.

environment.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environment.description: Connects self-improvement (optional: set it after deploying). A fine-grained GitHub token for the project's repository only, the agent's: Contents and Pull requests read and write (it pushes pikit/self/* branches and opens pull requests), Checks and Commit statuses read. admin-proposals reads proposals with it; it never merges.

environment.name: PIKIT_MERGE_TOKEN
environment.description: Connects self-improvement (optional: set it after deploying). Another fine-grained GitHub token for the same repository only, never the agent's: Contents and Pull requests read and write. It merges and closes the agent's pull requests when you approve or reject them in the dashboard.
